cited_by.title: Braids, cornrows and twists for men and boys

record.finding: Acne keloidalis nuchae (neck bumps) was found in 0.67% overall and 4.7% of final-year boys, all with frequent haircuts; most boys (72.8%) kept natural hair with haircuts within 4 weeks. Traction alopecia was 9.4% overall and 17.1% in girls, and was more common with relaxed than natural hair; 8.6% of boys had relaxed hair.
record.note: One country, one survey; association only; boys' braid-specific results are not reported in the abstract.
